responsibility: This header provides the AArch64 Windows GNU toolchain OS layer for Cygwin/MinGW-style environments, complementing the lower-level COFF support with PE/COFF and Windows ABI policy. It defines target preprocessor builtins for Win32/Win64, DLL import/export and stub symbol flags, PE section and named-section hooks, DWARF-on-PE emission details, object and function declaration output, type-size overrides such as 32-bit `long` and 16-bit `wchar_t`, stack-check policy, and other PE/COFF-specific assembler and LTO hooks needed by the AArch64 port.
